question: Should OpenClaw support a third, configurable WhatsApp group activation mode—temporary post-mention listening—rather than retaining only mention and always activation?
rationale: The implementation is additive, but it expands the public configuration and group-message policy contract; repository policy requires maintainer intent before accepting new config/activation behavior.

options.title: Sponsor the bounded mode
options.body: Accept the opt-in, default-disabled listen-window direction after real group-flow and upgrade evidence is added.

options.title: Keep existing activation modes
options.body: Decline this new configuration surface and retain the current mention-or-always model.

options.title: Request a narrower design
options.body: Ask for the behavior to be expressed through an existing activation or owner-controlled mechanism before adding persistent per-group options.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the bounded mode
recommendation.body: Accept the opt-in, default-disabled listen-window direction after real group-flow and upgrade evidence is added.

likelyOwner.reason: Low-confidence adjacent routing candidate for the WhatsApp/config product boundary.
